changelog.title: Friends show online again
sections: Fixed
With a long friend list, everyone showed as offline on Home. Roblox only answers 50 friends at a time, so HuiClient now asks in groups.

changelog.title: Your friends, your buttons
sections: New
Favorite friends and make folders for them on Home, like "FTAP friends". Drag friends in, or use their menu, and move friends and folders up or down.
Unfriend several friends at once: press Select in Friends. A pop-up names everyone first and points out your favorites.
Customize buttons: a pop-up with a live preview of the dock and the sidebar. Hold and drag buttons to move them, rename or hide them, and add dividers.
Put the dock at the top, make it smaller or larger, show names under its icons, or make the sidebar icons only.
Buttons for your own programs in the dock or the sidebar, with the program's own icon.
Answer messages without opening HuiClient: right-click a chat pop-up for a small chat window. Chats also have a Pop out button.
Choose whether banned and deleted accounts show in your friends list on Home.
Improved
A night sky behind everything, with stars, light rain and the odd comet, drifting slightly with the mouse.
Smoother animations when switching pages and tabs.

changelog.title: A new Home, and any Roblox version
sections: New
Home is rebuilt: the game you played last up top, then Continue playing, Favorites and Popular now in tidy grids, with "Show all" instead of arrow rows.
Your friends are always on the right of Home: who's in a game (with Join), who's online, and offline folded away.
Popular now switches between Roblox's lists (Top Trending, Up-and-Coming and more) with one click.
Choose a version in Settings > Deployment: install any Roblox version your version archive saved, with the day Roblox released it.
Every friend, follower and followed player of anyone: click the counts on a profile, with a search box for each list.
A Back button on game, profile and item pages.
Settings > About, with the Discord server and credits.
Improved
Updates download only what changed (about 1 MB instead of the 230 MB installer) and restart HuiClient by themselves.
The bottom dock names each button when you point at it.
Saved avatars open in 3D much faster.
Clicking an item in your avatar inventory opens its page.
Head shapes are listed by name under your avatar instead of covering it.
The favorite button sits next to Play, and the quick-join buttons say what they do.
Pages that need an account have a Log in button, and the dock shows one when you're logged out.
Fixed
Launching Roblox sometimes started it logged out, because HuiClient briefly couldn't read its own settings.
Fewest players now really shows the emptiest servers, and Join least full joins one.
Friends no longer show up without a name, and names load much faster.
Head shapes all showed the head you're wearing.
Saved outfits Roblox has no picture of show a grey stand-in instead of nothing.

changelog.title: A new way to sign in
sections: New
Signing in now happens inside HuiClient, on a full-window screen instead of a separate Roblox window.
Quick Log In: sign in with a code you confirm on your phone, no password needed.
A short welcome after you sign in.
Find players remembers the players you open, under Recent searches.
Saved avatars on every profile: see the avatars a player saved, each in 3D with its items and prices.
